name: _wrapped_linear_prepack
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_wrapped_linear_prepack(Tensor weight, Tensor weight_scale, Tensor weight_zero_point, Tensor bias) -> Tensor. Tests cover the FlagGems uint8 packed layout, metadata magic/version, qint8 ties-to-even rounding and clamping, contiguous and noncontiguous weights/bias, empty dimensions, and invalid qparam or bias shapes.
